answer_1.quote: We conduct comprehensive testing on both symbol-centric and NL-centric tasks, using a collection of 34 text-to-symbol generation tasks ...
answer_1.outputs: symbolic representations such as SQL queries, PDDL plans, code snippets, AMR graphs, first-order logic forms, etc.

answer_2.quote: We use the BLEU metric to measure the correctness of generated forms. For SQL we use Exact Match. For AMR we use Smatch. For WebQSP we use F1. For FOL we use Logic Equivalence (LE).
